rows.grounds: adverb introducing the continuation of the preceding statement
fused locative plural form with api; names campaka, punnaga, meru, and vakula groups, with api adding 'also'

items.question: Does this same attainment apply also to campaka, punnaga, meru, and vakula groups?
premises: The preceding attainment is extended to named groups.
This verse names campaka, punnaga, meru, and vakula.
The particle api signals inclusion of those groups.
items.inference: The same result is extended to these additional named groups.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of each named group remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Thus also in the campaka, punnaga, meru, and vakula groups.
